subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type between Sheet E-501 and Electrical

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type between Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 and Sheet E-501 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up rough-in in this area. Please respond at your earliest convenience.

Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 governs for the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type near LP-1; Sheet E-501 will be superseded by an updated drawing. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up rough-in in this area.
